title: Introducing Radiant Capital (RDNT) on Binance Launchpool! Farm RDNT by Staking BNB and TUSD
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance is excited to announce the 32st project on Binance Launchpool -  Radiant Capital (RDNT) , an omnichain money market protocol built on LayerZero. The  webpage  is estimated to be available in 4 hours, before the Launchpool starts.  Users will be able to stake their BNB and TUSD into separate pools to farm RDNT tokens over 40   days, with farming starting from 2023-03-31 00:00 (UTC). RDNT Launchpool Details: Token Name: Radiant Capital (RDNT) Total Token Supply: 1,000,000,000 RDNT  Launchpool Token Rewards: 15,000,000 RDNT (1.5% of total token supply) Circulating Supply: 217,696,083 (21.77% of the total token supply) Smart Contract Address: RDNT (Arbitrum  ERC-20 ) ( BNB Chain ) Staking Terms: No upper limit. KYC required  Supported Pools:  Stake BNB  (webpage will be available in around 4 hours): 12,000,000 RDNT in rewards (80%)  Stake TUSD  (webpage will be available in around 4 hours): 3,000,000 RDNT in rewards (20%) Farming Period: 2023-03-31 00:00 (UTC) to 2023-05-09 23:59 (UTC). RDNT Farming Distribution Dates (00:00:00 - 23:59:59 UTC each day) Total Daily Rewards (RDNT) BNB Pool Daily Rewards (RDNT) TUSD Pool Daily Rewards (RDNT) 2023-03-31 - 2023-05-09 375,000.00 300,000.00 	 75,000.00 Read about Radiant Capital (RDNT) in our research report  here . Please note: Snapshots of user balances and total pool balances will be taken each hour to calculate user rewards, which will also be updated each hour. Users will be able to accumulate their rewards (calculated each hour) and claim these rewards directly to their spot accounts at any time. Each pool’s annual percentage yield (APY) and total pool balance will be updated in real time. Tokens can only be staked in one pool at a time. For example, User A cannot stake the same BNB into two different pools at the same time, but can allocate 50% of their BNB into pool A and 50% into pool B. Users will be able to unstake their funds at any time with no delay and participate in any other available pools immediately. Tokens staked in each pool and also any unclaimed rewards will be automatically transferred to each user’s spot accounts at the end of each farming period. Binance BNB Vault will support the RDNT Launchpool. Users who have staked their BNB in BNB Vault will automatically participate in the RDNT Launchpool, and receive RDNT rewards daily in their Spot Wallets.  BNB staked into Launchpool will still provide users with the  standard benefits for holding BNB , such as airdrops, Launchpad eligibility and VIP benefits. Project Links Website:   https://radiant.capital/ Whitepaper:  https://docs.radiant.capital/radiant/ Telegram:  https://t.me/radiantcapitalofficial   Twitter:  https://twitter.com/RDNTCapital Discord:  https://discord.com/invite/radiantcapital Medium:  https://medium.com/@RadiantCapital   Reminder: Users need to complete their account verification and also be from an eligible jurisdiction to participate in farming RDNT.  * Users from the following countries or regions will not be able to participate in farming RDNT:  Belarus, Cuba, Democratic Republic of Congo, Iran, Crimea Region, New Zealand, North Korea, South Sudan, Syria, United States of America and its territories (American Samoa, Guam, Puerto Rico, the Northern Mariana Islands, and the U.S. Virgin Islands), Zimbabwe. Thanks for your support!
